review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: At least 7 years’ experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering or a comparable senior systems role, supporting business-critical on-premises systems.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We’re recruiting a hands-on Senior Systems Engineer to join a dedicated infrastructure team of five within a large, well-established organisation. Staying hands-on from design through to implementation and testing, and using PowerShell or other automation tools to simplify repeatable work. At least 7 years’ experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering or a comparable senior systems role, supporting business-critical on-premises systems. Deep hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, vCenter and ESXi, including upgrades and lifecycle management, and an understanding of how enterprise virtualisation is evolving. Hands-on enterprise backup and recovery experience with at least one of Veeam, Cohesity or Commvault.
